A link to a slide deck is shared far more often than the deck is opened, and a link with no card behind it previews as a bare URL.

`social` reads the social metadata already in a presentation's front matter and writes the corresponding `<meta>` tags into its head.

::: {.callout-important}
## Quarto now emits some of these itself

On the Quarto version this site is built with, a RevealJS deck already receives twelve social tags without any filter.
This extension adds seven that are still missing, `og:url` and `og:type` among them, and re-emits ten that Quarto has already written.

The [Examples](examples.qmd) page compares two identical decks, one built with the filter and one without, so the overlap is visible rather than described.
:::

## Installation

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This will install the extension under the `_extensions` subdirectory.
If you are using version control, you will want to check in this directory.

Or install it from your editor with [Quarto Wizard](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-wizard):

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

[Visual Studio Code](vscode://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Visual Studio Code using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[Positron](positron://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Positron using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[VSCodium](vscodium://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in VSCodium using the Quarto Wizard extension."}

:::

## Quick start

```yaml
filters:
  - social
```

The standard Quarto keys are enough:

```yaml
title: "The Grammar of Graphics Assembles"
description: "A talk on a native Typst grammar-of-graphics package."
site-url: "https://example.com/my-talk/"
image: "assets/social-card.png"
open-graph:
  image-width: 1200
  image-height: 630
twitter-card: true
```

::: {.callout-warning}
Social scrapers need an absolute `og:image` URL.
Set `site-url` so a relative image path is resolved against it, or give an absolute URL.
The filter warns when a relative path is used without one.
:::

See the [Reference](reference.qmd) for every tag and where its value comes from, and the [Examples](examples.qmd) for the two decks compared.

## Where it works

RevealJS.
